title: Kilometre stones on the way to Delhi
body: Padma was travelling by bus to visit her grandparents in Delhi. Eager to reach, she kept reading the kilometre stones on the side of the road. One stone read 'Delhi 70 km'. A little later, the next stone she noticed read 'Delhi 60 km'. Each kilometre stone told her how far she was from Delhi at that moment. Her teacher had explained that when distance is stated with respect to a fixed object or point, that point is called a reference point, and that the position of a moving object changes with respect to the reference point with time.
